title: Preethse
desc: Surya, a military commander, is soon to be engaged to Kiran, a college student. Unbeknownst to him, one of Kiran's classmates is also in love with her.

title: Aranmanai 3
desc: Jyothi, the daughter of a landlord, gets haunted by an unknown entity in her childhood. However, when the spirit begins to trouble another member of her family, she decides to uncover its identity.

title: Mufti
desc: Gana, a police officer, must go undercover to find and kill Bhairathi Ranagal, a crime lord. However, when he realises that Bhairathi's intentions are good, he needs to decide his next step.

title: Lucky Subramanya
desc: Lucky goes for a job interview where the woman who rejected him turns out to be his employer. Afraid that she will not hire him, he decides to change his identity.

title: Nunakuzhi
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur's flawless facade crumbles when his company faces a high-profile IT raid, revealing a complex network of tax evasion and illicit dealings that threaten to destroy his empire.

title: Take It Easy
desc: Dhanraj, a middle-class man, and his family struggle to navigate through their financial issues. Soon, he sets out on a quest to buy a car despite not being able to afford it.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Jogi
desc: After a crime lord is murdered by Madesha, Nivedhitha, a journalist, sets out to meet him. She ends up meeting an old woman and promises to help her find her son, who is none other than Madesha.
